description: Zero‑dependency, Type‑safe Node.js framework with native HTTP/2 + HTTP/3, AI‑driven routing and edge‑first performance – the Express‑style API re‑imagined for 2026.
npm_trending_strategy: Leverages three 2026‑level trends in a single package: native HTTP/3 (QUIC) for sub‑millisecond latency, built‑in AI‑powered route selection that auto‑optimizes for LLM workloads, and an edge‑first deployment model that runs unchanged on Cloudflare Workers, Bun, Deno and serverless runtimes. All of this with zero runtime dependencies and full TypeScript typings, giving developers a drop‑in Express‑style API that outperforms Fastify and Nest on modern edge infrastructure.
download_hooks: Developers choose yantravese because it delivers the fastest request‑to‑response times on the edge without pulling in any third‑party modules.
Performance angle: native HTTP/3 + QUIC + zero‑dependency design shaves up to 70 % latency compared to Fastify on the same hardware.
Developer experience angle: Express‑style API, complete TypeScript definitions, and AI‑driven routing let you write less code and let the framework auto‑scale your LLM endpoints.
